context_content_data.rationale: The candidate directly fulfills the prompt by outlining a specific, meaningful future plan to educate illiterate villagers after the HSC examination.
context_content_data.evidence: After the HSC Exam, I will go to my village. In my village, there are many illiterate people. They don't know how to live, a happy and healthy life. I want to educate them.

structure_format_brevity.rationale: All core structural components of an informal letter are intact and properly placed: date, address, salutation, body paragraphs, subscription, signature, and postal envelope layout.

language_mechanics.rationale: The script contains persistent mechanical and grammatical errors, including irregular plural errors, gerund/infinitive misuse, faulty punctuation, and incorrect possessive forms.
language_mechanics.evidence: Their childs also don't get education. Because of this they also do many works to live a happy life. If they educated well, they will do work.

originality_comparisons_paraphrase.rationale: The letter moves beyond generic template statements in the core body, logically developing the candidate's personal social work ambition and extending an authentic invitation to the friend.
originality_comparisons_paraphrase.evidence: If you don't have any plan after the HSC Exam, you can join with me. You will also help me to educate the people of my village.

frequent_errors: Incorrect noun pluralization ('childs' instead of 'children', 'many works')
Faulty preposition and verb construction ('how to farming', 'for live')
Punctuation anomalies ('Now. I am going to describe')
positive_aspects: Flawless structural layout adhering to all NCTB informal letter conventions
Clear, focused narrative on post-exam community service plans
Coherent progression of ideas with an appropriate informal closing

feedback_summary: The candidate delivers a fully structured informal letter with all necessary components present. The purpose is clearly communicated with a constructive and positive post-HSC plan. While grammatical errors and non-standard phrasing prevent full marks in language mechanics, the script merits the lower end of Band 4 (4/5) due to its structural completeness and contextual clarity.
